class.name: GAS_Entity
class.brief_description: Node representing an active character participating in the Gameplay Ability System.
class.description:
[GAS_Entity] serves as the main integration component for an actor in the Gameplay Ability System (GAS).
It connects attribute management ([AttributeContainer]) and state/tag tracking ([TagContainer]) into a single interface. It provides capabilities to apply gameplay effects ([EffectData]), manage active modifiers, and query system stats or status tags on the attached node.

method.name: add_effect
method.description: Applies a [EffectData] to this entity. Returns an integer identifier representing the active effect instance.

method.name: get_attribute_container
method.description: Returns the assigned [AttributeContainer] node associated with this entity.

method.name: get_tag_container
method.description: Return current [TagContainer] associated to this entity.

method.name: set_attribute_container
method.description: Assigns the [AttributeContainer] node used by this entity to manage attribute sets and stats.

method.name: set_tag_container
method.description: Assigns the [TagContainer] node used by this entity to track active gameplay tags.
